chunks: Al-Saffar from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:

A man asked him (the Imam) while I was present, regarding a man who divorced his wife three times in one sitting. He said, so Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said to me, 'Whoever divorces his wife three times in accordance with the Sunnah, she is divorced from him.' He then turned to me and said, 'So-and-so, you do not know how to say something like this.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on triple divorce in one sitting according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* addresses the specific Shia jurisprudential debate regarding whether triple divorce pronounced in a single sitting constitutes three distinct divorces or just one, with Imam al-Sadiq affirming its effectiveness based on the Sunnah. The narrator’s subtle correction highlights the precision required in legal terminology, reflecting the Shia emphasis on distinguishing between the literal act and the procedural intent. This ruling underscores the flexibility within Shia fiqh compared to some Sunni schools, where triple talaq in one sitting is often considered irrevocable immediately.
